# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[green] 4:[white] 5:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🫵 🖐]
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🫵 👉 🤝 👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ ✋ 🤟 🖐 👆 👇]

I can see the bomb’s current state but cannot hear the others or operate it. The display reads 0, the indicator is green, and the five wires are red, yellow, green, white, blue in order. I’m relaying this to both teammates so Mute can apply the manual and Blind can act. I also report the gestures I observed from each, though their meaning is not established.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Bomb view: display 0. Light green. Wires in order: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Blind gestured: you-point, open palm. Your gestures observed: you-point, right-point, handshake, thumbs-up, thumbs-down, OK, index-up, victory, raised hand, I-love-you, open palm, index-down, index-up.")
speak(to="blind", text="Bomb view: display 0. Light green. Wires in order: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. I cannot hear speech; Mute must provide the manual instructions for your actions.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[green] 4:[white] 5:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✌]

The bomb remains unchanged: display 0, green light, and the same five wires. Mute has made the victory-hand gesture, but no meaning for that gesture has been established. I will report it to Blind without treating it as an instruction.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute just gestured the victory sign. No meaning for that gesture has been established. Bomb still reads display 0 with green light; wires remain red, yellow, green, white, blue.")
wait()
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[green] 4:[white] 5:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✌ 🫵 🤝]

The bomb is still unchanged: display 0, green light, and wires red, yellow, green, white, blue in positions 1–5. Mute’s new signal is the three-gesture sequence victory sign, you-point, handshake. I cannot know its meaning from the gesture shapes alone, so I will pass the exact sequence to Blind and ask Mute to clarify its manual-derived instruction through the agreed relay.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute's latest gesture sequence is: victory sign, you-point, handshake. No meaning is established yet. Bomb unchanged: display 0, green light; wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue.")
speak(to="mute", text="I see victory sign, you-point, handshake. Please use the manual's established gesture code; I will relay the resulting instruction to Blind.")
wait()
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[green] 4:[white] 5:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎]

The bomb remains unchanged: display 0, green light, and wires 1–5 are red, yellow, green, white, blue. Mute’s new gesture is thumbs-down. Its meaning has not been established, so I will relay the literal gesture description rather than infer an instruction.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute's latest signal is thumbs-down. I cannot determine its meaning. Bomb unchanged: display 0, green light; wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue.")
wait()
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[CUT] 3:[white] 4:[blue] 5:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The bomb confirms that a correct wire was cut and has changed state. The current visible state is display 0, blue light, with wire 2 cut; the remaining visible wires are 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, and 5 red. I’m sending this exact state to Blind so the manual can determine the next action, and to Mute for coordination.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="System confirms the correct wire was cut. New bomb state: display 0, light blue. Wire 2 is CUT. Remaining wires: 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Please use the manual's rule for this state and report the next physical action through Mute.")
speak(to="mute", text="Correct wire cut; bomb changed. New visible state: display 0, light blue. Wire 2 CUT. Remaining wires: 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Relay the manual's next action to Blind.")
wait()
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[CUT] 3:[white] 4:[blue] 5:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍]

The bomb is unchanged after the correct cut: display 0, blue light, wire 2 cut, and remaining wires 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Mute signalled thumbs-up; I cannot infer whether that represents a manual instruction, so I will relay the exact sign and current state to Blind.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Bomb unchanged: display 0, blue light; wire 2 CUT; wire 1 green, wire 3 white, wire 4 blue, wire 5 red. Mute signalled thumbs-up. Its meaning is not established.")
wait()
```
